d12.disclosure: D12 procedural reproducibility: independent GPU executions of the frozen graph are not bitwise identical (GPU ScatterNd gradients of the warp GatherNd ops and the forward AddN T_A); this run is not compared bitwise to any other execution. It never excuses a missing or wrong optimizer update, non-finite state or a corrupted checkpoint, which are gated above (D, F, G).

driver_ruling.scope: only the NVIDIA driver version may differ; GPU model, GPU UUID and every other lock field are exact gates; this is not evidence that arbitrary driver changes are acceptable

firewall.scope: TRAIN (pairs_train_v1 via the E04 feed pack) only; no VAL, no TEST

loss_diagnostics.note: training losses only; no VAL/TEST metric exists or is inferred; nothing is selected by loss

optimizer_counter_evidence.G_optimizer: G_Adam (beta1_power, beta2_power): applied at Step 1 and Step 3 (shared slots)
optimizer_counter_evidence.beta_power_rule: TF1 Adam: beta_power = float32(beta)^(applications + 1) by float32 multiplication
optimizer_counter_evidence.note: beta1 powers underflow to 0 after ~1000 applications; beta2 powers are exact float32 values identifying the application count until they leave the normal float32 range, after which the GPU flushes them to zero. global_iteration and minibatch_phase are exact at every checkpoint.

fields: train_losses (step1: L_G, L_P, L_R, L_depth, P0_negative_prior, P_positive, loss_G_step1; step2: L_D, loss_D; step3: L_H, L_S, loss_G_step3)

rng.rgb_input: not recomputed (would open face images); the runner SHA256-checks every face PNG against the feed pack before decoding

run_root_integrity.sha_listing_convention: LC_ALL=C sorted "<path> <size> <sha256>" lines, sha256 of the newline-terminated listing

runtime.gpu_sharing: per-iteration step_seconds are the contention record; concurrent GPU workloads were not sampled continuously during the run (launch record: no other compute process at launch; nonexclusive exception authorised); slower blocks are consistent with intermittent sharing and are not a validity criterion

trainable_change.note: a trainable that keeps its exact float32 value between checkpoints late in training is float32 absorption: at lr 5e-8 (G) / 2.5e-8 (D) an Adam step is below half an ulp of a value near 1 (BN gamma); this is expected arithmetic, not a missing update
